description: Source code for handling image tags in firmware, including CRC calculations, fixup, and validation functions for embedded device firmware images.

classes.name: bcm_tag
classes.description: Structure representing the firmware image tag with metadata and CRCs.

methods.name: strntoul
methods.description: Converts a string to an unsigned long with specified length and base.

methods.name: compute_crc32
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum over a specified file region.

methods.name: trx_fixup
methods.description: Fixes up the imagetag header CRC and related fields in firmware images.

methods.name: trx_check
methods.description: Validates the firmware image header CRC and size compatibility.

methods.name: mtd_fixtrx
methods.description: Fixes the TRX header in a specified MTD device offset.
